localBiteReport: Reports from the past week or two on Choctawhatchee Bay show a solid but somewhat inconsistent bite — fishing has been productive when anglers get out, though quality fish have been a bit harder to come by. Redfish remain the standout inshore target, with keeper-sized reds being caught around bridge structures and in the bay's deeper cuts; live bait has been the go-to early morning, with soft plastics working well throughout the day. Water temperature is 70°F. The most recent captainexperiences.com guide report (approximately one week ago) notes that the bay bite has been weather-dependent but good when conditions cooperate. The FishingBooker Choctawhatchee Bay feed, updated within the past week, shows anglers landing redfish around bridges and deeper bay areas on guided trips out of Destin/Freeport.
